text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnnngh............

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(There has to be... more I can do... What 
should I...――)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp! Ah, oh no... I finished the whole 
bag...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, the day before, t-today too... 
............... Ah, my weight—

Today, like any other day, it's training 
time. I'm having Cheval Grand go through 
the menu while giving instructions, but...
choice_data_list: Cheval, about the next item on the menu...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hyah! I-I'm so sorry...!!
choice_data_list:
? You have nothing to apologize for, you 
know...?

text_block_list.text:
"If anything, her condition is so good 
that I'm thinking of increasing the 
workload a bit more than planned. I went 
on to explain the details—"
choice_data_list: Think you can make it?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... I'm really sorry. I-I'll do my 
best, so...—

...She's been acting distant today for 
some reason. Or rather, she seems awfully 
jumpy.

“Still, her training quality is excellent. 
If anything, she's pushing herself harder 
than usual.”
choice_data_list: (Cheval really is such a hard worker)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...T-Thank you for your hard work...

Silently continuing her training, she 
diligently completed every single menu 
item. I have to make sure to praise her 
for this!
choice_data_list: Good work! Cheval, today—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Kh! I-I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll make up for it properly! Thank you 
for your hard work...!!
choice_data_list: Huh, Cheval...!?

text_block_list.text:
I was about to review things and praise 
her, when she suddenly ran off. I have to 
chase after her for now...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah—! This isn't enough, I need 
more...!
choice_data_list: Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so so—
choice_data_list: Wait, calm down for a second...!

text_block_list.text:
For now, I calmed Cheval Grand down and 
asked her what had happened...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I think Trainer was about to point 
that out earlier, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I was just... careless, or, 
well...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I, I've gained... weight...
choice_data_list: Huh... Is that how it was?
Huh... Is that how it was?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Weren't you trying to warn me about 
gaining weight from snacking too much...?
choice_data_list: N-no, that's not it...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!? I-I'm so sorry! I... misunderstood 
completely...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, I've had a lot on my mind 
lately, so I ended up... snacking out of 
habit again..."
choice_data_list:
Deep in thought... Is something troubling 
you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ......I-I want to live up to it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... is always putting so much 
thought into things for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Things like the training menu, the race 
rotation, and so much more...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...So, I've been thinking... about what I 
can do to live up to that, and...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, in the end... far from living up 
to expectations, I couldn't even manage my 
own condition... I'm so sorry...

To think that you wanted to live up to my 
expectations... Knowing you felt that way 
fills me with the utmost warmth.
choice_data_list:
I was actually meaning to praise you 
earlier.

I was actually meaning to praise you 
earlier.
Look at you, such a hard worker after all.

Look at you, such a hard worker after all, 
huh?

text_block_list.text:
To think that you wanted to live up to my 
expectations... Knowing you felt that way 
fills me with the utmost warmth.
choice_data_list:
I was actually meaning to praise you 
earlier.

I was actually meaning to praise you 
earlier.
Look at you, such a hard worker after all.

Look at you, such a hard worker after all, 
huh?

text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand is truly a hard worker. She 
dutifully carries out her training 
regimen, making steady progress day by 
day, even if it's slow.
choice_data_list:
This is the result of your hard work to 
live up to expectations.

This is the result of your hard work to 
live up to expectations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...B-But... in the end, I still ended up 
gaining weight..."

In other words, though, this is a chance 
to grow. It's a necessary step for Cheval 
Grand to reach the next stage.
choice_data_list: Seeing you grow makes me really happy.
Seeing you grow makes me truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —A-Are you happy...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………U-Um... I'll grow... even more...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.text:
However, there's no need to push herself. 
Running freely at her own pace and growing 
slowly—that would be best.
choice_data_list: That alone is enough to keep me going.
That alone is enough to keep me going.

text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand works harder than anyone 
else. ...Sometimes even a little too hard. 
That's why I need to make sure to pace her 
properly—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...——No... I don't want to.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I-I'm so sorry, so sorry! Talking all 
cheekily like that...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's just, um... I-If possible, I 
really... want to live up to my Trainer's 
expectations, so...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――Please let me do my best. ...Even more.

Cheval Grand exuded a quiet yet powerful 
resolve. I was momentarily overwhelmed by 
it, but... it only made me look forward to 
her future even more.
